description: Audit a website for AI agents and AI search (AEO/GEO): scan it the way ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity fetch it and score it 0-100 (60 core points plus 40 for the job). Checks robots.txt rules for AI bots, bot walls and firewalls, server-rendered content, structured data, llms.txt, sitemap, pricing and sign-up pages, OpenAPI and MCP. Returns the score, every failed check with its fix, and the checks it passed. Read-only scan, cached for 24 hours; it does not run an agent on the site.

domain.description: The site to check, like example.com

job.description: What agents should do on the site: recommend (answer questions about it), buy, signup, api (get an API key) or personal (a person's own site: who they are, their work, how to reach them). Leave out to detect it.

name: check_site
title: Check a site's agent readiness
